name: ModuleScript
simple: A ModuleScript is a script that does not run by itself. Instead, other scripts load it with `require()`, and it hands back one value, usually a table full of functions and settings. This lets you write code once and use it from many scripts.
analogy: A ModuleScript is like a recipe book on a shelf. It does not cook anything by itself, but any chef (script) can take it down with `require` and use its recipes.
whenToUse: Share the same functions between many scripts instead of copying and pasting.
Store game settings in one place, like walk speeds or prices.
Share code between the server and clients by putting the module in ReplicatedStorage.
where: Can live almost anywhere. It runs on whichever side requires it: on the server when a Script requires it, on the client when a LocalScript requires it. Put it in ReplicatedStorage to share with both sides, in ServerScriptService or ServerStorage for server-only code, or in StarterPlayerScripts for client-only code.

terms.server: Roblox's computer that runs the one shared copy of the game for everyone in the server. What happens here is the truth everyone sees.
terms.client: One player's own device (computer, phone, tablet, or console). Each player has their own client.
terms.require: The built-in function that loads a ModuleScript and gives you the value it returns: `local M = require(path.To.Module)`.
terms.return: The word at the end of a module that says which value to hand back to whoever requires it.
terms.table: A Luau container that holds many values, like a list or a set of named things.
terms.yield: To pause and wait. If a module pauses while loading, the script that required it waits too.

examples.title: Share a math helper between scripts
examples.place: ModuleScript named MathHelper in ReplicatedStorage, plus a Script in ServerScriptService
examples.code:
-- ===== ModuleScript "MathHelper" in ReplicatedStorage =====
local MathHelper = {}

-- Adds a bonus percentage to a number of coins
function MathHelper.addBonus(coins, percent)
	return coins + coins * percent / 100
end

MathHelper.MAX_COINS = 1000

return MathHelper -- hand this table to whoever requires us

-- ===== Script in ServerScriptService =====
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MathHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MathHelper"))

print(MathHelper.addBonus(200, 10)) --> 220
print(MathHelper.MAX_COINS)          --> 1000
explain: The module makes an empty table, adds a function and a setting to it, and returns it at the end.
The Script calls `require` with the module and gets that table back.
Now it can call `MathHelper.addBonus(200, 10)`: 10 percent of 200 is 20, so it gives 220.

gotchas: A module runs only once per side. Every later `require` gets the exact same table back, so changes one script makes to it are seen by others on that same side.
The server and each client get their OWN separate copy. Changing a module's table on the server does not change it on clients.
If module A requires module B and B requires A, the scripts get stuck forever with no error. Avoid loops like that.
A module must return exactly one value. Forgetting `return` causes an error when required.

ModuleScript.LinkedSource.simple: Old — use Packages instead to share code between places.

ModuleScript.Source.simple: The text of the module's code, which you edit in Studio's script editor. Normal game scripts cannot change it; plugins can read it, and should use ScriptEditorService to edit an open script.
